scripts.ci:check: npx concurrently --names "formatting","types","knip","llms-txt","gateway-version","test" --prefix-colors "yellow,blue,magenta,cyan,green,red" "pnpm run format:check" "pnpm run types:check" "pnpm run knip" "pnpm run llms-txt:check" "pnpm run gateway-version:check" "pnpm run test"
scripts.dev: npx concurrently --names "todo-app,every-app-gateway" --prefix-colors "blue,green" "cd apps/todo-app && pnpm run dev" "cd apps/every-app-gateway && pnpm run dev"
